The '''Growdi Harmonique''' was a [[Wikipedia:harmonica|harmonica]]-like instrument used in [[Shanpa]] [[Music/Legends|music]]. It was also described as a combination of [[Flute/Legends|flute]] and water organ, and was played by [[Rappertunie/Legends|Rappertunie]] in the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]].
